essence: One should utter dīn, bhīṣaya, and the sound-arising word at the end of the phrase
Having uttered 'cala' and 'sakala', one should then utter from the mantra-limb word
One should utter 'jvaroccāṭana sarva' and also the phrase for obstacle destruction
At the end of the all-evil phrase one should likewise add the destruction word
One should utter 'sarvaśatrucchedana' for oneself and for another
